short.scope: complete gate, conservative upper measurement for individual rung commands

moderate.scope: complete gate, conservative upper measurement for individual rung commands

long.scope: complete gate, conservative upper measurement for individual rung commands

eternal.basis: ten times sum of short/moderate/long command classes; whole rung orchestration guard

resource_admission.derivation: min(nproc/8, (MemAvailable-6GiB)/6GiB per worker); headroom for concurrent children and gates

guard_table.limitation: No durable repository class table; temporary table uses existing Spiral gate receipts, not a per-rung benchmark. File conformance follow-up.
